title: Tip Calculator Adds 100x Too Much
description:
`calculate_total_with_tip(bill, tip_percent)` should return the bill plus a tip of `tip_percent` percent. Right now it treats the percent as a plain fraction instead of dividing by 100 first. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`calculate_total_with_tip(bill: float, tip_percent: float) -> float`

**Example**
`calculate_total_with_tip(100, 20)` -> `120.0` (20% of 100 is 20).
